title: Think Fast, Chucklenuts
blurb: The warning arrives simultaneously with the projectile, which is technically a warning and legally quite a different thing. This ambush line spread through Team Fortress 2 clips and meme edits until it became the internet's standard way of announcing incoming chaos to somebody who has no time to act on the information. Play it before tossing anything at anybody: keys, a drink, a compliment, an unwanted responsibility. The word chucklenuts is what elevates the whole thing to art — without it you have a warning, with it you have a genre.
origin: A viral ambush line popularized through TF2 and meme edits.
